data.one_liner: Extend Flutter TextFields to support tagging capabilities like user mentions and hashtags.
data.what_it_does: FlutterTagger extends standard Flutter TextFields to enable tagging triggers such as '@' and '#'. It provides callbacks for search queries, custom styling for tagged results, and controllers to retrieve formatted text and tags.
use_when: You are building a social media or messaging app requiring user mentions.
You need hashtag highlighting and extraction inside text fields.
avoid_when: You only need standard text input without custom trigger characters or inline tagging overlays.
strengths: Supports multiple trigger characters and styles simultaneously.
Includes customizable overlay views for search results.
Provides clean access to formatted text and applied tags.
weaknesses: Relies on a specific controller and builder pattern which might require restructuring existing text input code.
